solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage **describes the benefits of medical machines providing real-time information to healthcare professionals.**
 
• The word** "enabling"** fits well as it means allowing someone** to do something or making it possible for something to happen.**
 
• The correct word for fill in the blanks no. 5 is** 'enabling'.**
 
• Hence, the correct statement from the given passage is **"****Furthermore, medical machines provide healthcare professionals with real-time information, enabling __them to make informed decisions and adjust treatment plans accordingly.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Reimagining" **(फिर से कल्पना करना): Refers to imagining in a new way, which does not fit the context here.
 
• **"Adapting"** (अनुकूल बनाना): Modifying or adjusting, which does not convey the idea of facilitating or making possible.
 
• **"Neglecting" **(उपेक्षा करना): Failing to care for properly, which is the opposite of the intended meaning.
